class_size_limits_001.evidence: APS and ATF agree to follow the statutory class size limits and discontinue the District-wide waiver.

class_elementary_max_002.answer: Kindergarten: 20. Grades 1-3: average class load shall not exceed 22. Grades 4-6: average class load shall not exceed 24.
class_elementary_max_002.evidence: Kindergarten 20... Grades 1-3 The average class load at an individual elementary school shall not exceed 22 students. Grades 4-6 The average class load at an individual elementary school shall not exceed 24 students.

class_secondary_max_003.answer: Grades 7-12: 160 daily teaching load. English 7-8: 135 daily/27 per class. English 9-12: 150 daily/30 per class.

class_overage_remedy_004.evidence: The teacher is entitled to an instructional assistant with a class load of 15 or more students. The teacher is entitled to a full-time instructional assistant with a class load of 21 or more students.
